figures.Fig15.17: Receptors of taste (PDF page 44). Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch15-fig-15-17-taste-receptors (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book's 'tongue map' (sweet at the tip, sour at the sides, bitter at the back) is now regarded as outdated, and most textbooks add umami as a fifth basic taste. The lesson carries the book's statement and notes this, flagged.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
